name: Cyprus

paths.name: New resident (non-dom for 17 years, then standard rules)
paths.note: No special defence contribution on dividends while non-domiciled; afterwards 5% on dividends, which foreign withholding usually covers. No tax on gains from listed securities, no inheritance tax.

checks.working: Non-domiciled residents are exempt from special defence contribution on dividends (SDC Law, non-dom exemption); gains on listed securities are excluded from capital gains tax, which applies only to Cypriot real estate and shares holding it (CGT Law).

After the non-dom period: special defence contribution of 5% on dividends (rate as reduced for 2026) = 1,000 on 20,000 of Cypriot dividends; listed-security gains still outside capital gains tax. Total 1,000.
Cyprus abolished estate duty from 1 January 2000; there is no inheritance tax.

assumptions: A family that has just moved: the non-dom period runs from year 1.
